purpose: Strict P numerator: sparse goal/result vectors, inner-product alignment, goal-compact quality gate.

goal_schema.g_vector: implicit sparse map dim_id → weight from dims[]
goal_schema.source: five-paragraph O+V via goal-field.py OR inherited standing thread

formulas.dot_gr: Σ_k g_k · r_k over shared dims
formulas.P_align: 100 * max(0, dot_gr / dot_gg) when dot_gg > 0 else null
formulas.P_compact: 1 - compact_orth_penalty; default 1.0 if no compaction event
formulas.compact_orth_penalty: mean of ‖x−proj_g(x)‖/‖x‖ over chunks removed at park/compact
formulas.P_final: P_align * P_compact; if any required dim r_k=0 then P_align=0

session_rules.default_expect_P100: user_turns > 1 implies P_final must be 100 or session fail
session_rules.probe_exempt: scope=probe allows P < 100 with explicit note
session_rules.ask_policy: questions only at task start (turn 1); mid_task_ask_count > 0 penalizes P_compact
session_rules.question_form: Every question ships with a recommended answer, so silence is a valid and safe reply. A question the agent could answer by reading the repo is not a question but a skipped read; a question with no recommendation transfers the agent's work to the operator.
session_rules.question_form_origin: external_learning: _registry/fames-evidence/ingest-20260814-social-skills.json claim C1 (asserted, trialled, verdict adapt)

goal_compact_link.projection: keep chunk iff |⟨ĝ, x_chunk⟩| large; drop ⊥g even if salient
goal_compact_link.age_weight: f(age) multiplies keep_weight; orthogonality is primary
goal_compact_link.phase_transition: if g changes, invalidate prior compact residue — re-SCF
